versions.content: With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameter contextDataSize of the function IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithTimestampCountContextData , and shall report the development error IDSM_E_PARAM_LENGTH when the value of the parameter exceeds the maximum configured context data buffer size. The maximum context data buffer size results from the largest configured IdsMContextDataBufferSize .
